4 core entity tables, their relationships, indexes, and Mermaid diagram.

## **Entity 1 — users**

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique user identifier |
| email | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL, UNIQUE | User email address |
| username | VARCHAR(30) | NOT NULL, UNIQUE | Public display username |
| display\_name | VARCHAR(60) | NOT NULL | Full display name |
| avatar\_url | TEXT | NULLABLE | Profile photo URL (Cloudinary) |
| role | ENUM('buyer','seller','both','admin') | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 'buyer' | User role on platform |
| account\_status | ENUM('active','suspended','banned','deleted') | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 'active' | Account standing |
| auth\_provider | ENUM('email','google','apple') | NOT NULL | Authentication method used |
| email\_verified | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | Email verification status |
| password\_hash | TEXT | NULLABLE | Hashed password (null for OAuth users) |
| two\_factor\_enabled | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | 2FA active status |
| two\_factor\_secret | TEXT | NULLABLE | 2FA secret key (encrypted) |
| holiday\_mode | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | Listings paused status |
| stripe\_customer\_id | VARCHAR(255) | NULLABLE, UNIQUE | Stripe customer ID for payments |
| stripe\_connect\_id | VARCHAR(255) | NULLABLE, UNIQUE | Stripe Connect ID for payouts |
| bank\_account\_last4 | VARCHAR(4) | NULLABLE | Last 4 digits of linked bank (display only) |
| bank\_sort\_code\_masked | VARCHAR(10) | NULLABLE | Masked sort code (display only) |
| suspension\_end\_date | TIMESTAMP | NULLABLE | When suspension expires (null if permanent) |
| suspension\_reason | TEXT | NULLABLE | Reason for suspension |
| total\_sales | INTEGER | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0 | Completed sales count |
| average\_rating | DECIMAL(3,2) | NULLABLE | Cumulative star rating (e.g. 4.75) |
| review\_count | INTEGER | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0 | Total reviews received |
| verified\_seller | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | Verified seller badge status |
| violation\_count | INTEGER | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0 | Number of admin-ruled violations |
| last\_active\_at | TIMESTAMP | NULLABLE | Most recent platform activity |
| notification\_order\_updates | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Order update notifications on/off |
| notification\_messages | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Message notifications on/off |
| notification\_price\_drops | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Price drop alerts on/off |
| notification\_promotions | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | Promotional notifications on/off |
| notification\_disputes | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Dispute notifications on/off |
| preferred\_sports | JSONB | NULLABLE | Array of preferred sport IDs |
| privacy\_profile\_public | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Profile visible to other users |
| privacy\_data\_sharing | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Personalisation data sharing |
| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | Account creation timestamp |
| updated\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | Last update timestamp |
| deleted\_at | TIMESTAMP | NULLABLE | Soft delete timestamp |

**Relationships:**

* users.id → listings.seller\_id (one user can have many listings)  
* users.id → orders.buyer\_id (one user can have many purchases)  
* users.id → orders.seller\_id (one user can have many sales)  
* users.id → reviews.reviewer\_id (one user can leave many reviews)  
* users.id → reviews.seller\_id (one user can receive many reviews)

**Indexes:**

* UNIQUE INDEX on users.email  
* UNIQUE INDEX on users.username  
* INDEX on users.account\_status  
* INDEX on users.role  
* INDEX on users.verified\_seller

## **Mermaid ERD — Core EntitiesCore entities are done. Here is a summary of what was created:**

**4 tables — 107 columns total:**

| Entity | Columns | Key relationships |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| users | 37 | Root entity — connects to everything |
| listings | 27 | Belongs to users, sports, sub\_categories, brands |
| orders | 28 | Connects users (buyer \+ seller) to listings |
| payments | 29 | One-to-one with orders, mirrors Stripe data |

**Key design decisions made:**

* All primary keys are UUID — more secure than auto-increment integers, works better with distributed systems  
* Orders store price snapshots (snapshot\_listing\_title, snapshot\_condition, snapshot\_photos) — so if a seller edits a listing after purchase, the order record always shows what the buyer actually paid for  
* Payments table mirrors Stripe — every Stripe ID stored so you can always cross-reference against Stripe's dashboard  
* Soft deletes on users (deleted\_at) — GDPR compliance, data retained for audit but user is inactive  
* JSONB for photos array and preferred\_sports — flexible, no need for a separate junction table

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |

| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique sport identifier |
| name | VARCHAR(50) | NOT NULL, UNIQUE | Sport name e.g. Cricket |
| slug | VARCHAR(50) | NOT NULL, UNIQUE | URL-safe name e.g. cricket |
| icon\_url | TEXT | NOT NULL | Sport icon image URL |
| sport\_tag | ENUM('bat\_ball','racket','team','endurance','snow','water','combat','precision') | NOT NULL | Sport type tag |

| status | ENUM('active','hidden') | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 'active' | Visibility on platform |

## **Entity 8 — offers**

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique offer/message thread identifier |
| listing\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → listings.id | Listing the offer is about |
| buyer\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → users.id | Buyer who initiated the offer |
| seller\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → users.id | Seller receiving the offer |
| status | ENUM('active','completed','expired','closed') | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 'active' | Thread status |

* reviews.order\_id → orders.id (one review per order)  
* reviews.reviewer\_id → users.id (buyer leaves review)  
* reviews.seller\_id → users.id (seller receives review)

**Indexes:**

* UNIQUE INDEX on reviews.order\_id  
* INDEX on reviews.seller\_id  
* INDEX on reviews.reviewer\_id  
* INDEX on reviews.rating  
* INDEX on reviews.is\_visible  
* INDEX on reviews.created\_at DESC

## **Entity 13 — favourites**

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique favourite identifier |
| user\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → users.id | User who saved the listing |
| listing\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → listings.id | Saved listing |
| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | When item was saved |

**Relationships:**

* favourites.user\_id → users.id (one user has many favourites)  
* favourites.listing\_id → listings.id (one listing can be saved by many users)

**Indexes:**

* UNIQUE INDEX on favourites.user\_id \+ listing\_id (prevent duplicate saves)  
* INDEX on favourites.user\_id  
* INDEX on favourites.listing\_id  
* INDEX on favourites.created\_at DESC

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique audit log entry |
| admin\_id | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → users.id | Admin who performed the action |
| action\_type | ENUM('listing\_flagged','listing\_removed','listing\_restored','user\_suspended','user\_banned','user\_reinstated','dispute\_ruled','badge\_granted','badge\_revoked','fee\_updated','category\_added','category\_edited','category\_removed','sport\_added','sport\_hidden') | NOT NULL | Type of admin action |
| target\_type | VARCHAR(50) | NOT NULL | Entity type affected e.g. listing, user, dispute |
| target\_id | UUID | NOT NULL | ID of the affected entity |
| previous\_value | JSONB | NULLABLE | State before the action |
| new\_value | JSONB | NULLABLE | State after the action |
| reason | TEXT | NULLABLE | Admin-provided reason |
| internal\_note | TEXT | NULLABLE | Admin internal note |
| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | When action was taken |

**Relationships:**

* audit\_log.admin\_id → users.id (many log entries created by one admin)

**Indexes:**

* INDEX on audit\_log.admin\_id  
* INDEX on audit\_log.action\_type  
* INDEX on audit\_log.target\_type  
* INDEX on audit\_log.target\_id  
* INDEX on audit\_log.created\_at DESC

## **Entity 18 — fee\_config**

| Column Name | Data Type | Constraints | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen\_random\_uuid() | Unique config record identifier |

| config\_value | DECIMAL(10,4) | NOT NULL | Config value e.g. 5.0000 |
| config\_type | ENUM('percentage','flat\_amount','boolean') | NOT NULL | Value type |
| description | TEXT | NOT NULL | Plain English description |
| sport\_id | UUID | NULLABLE, FOREIGN KEY → sports.id | Sport-specific override (null \= global) |
| is\_promotional | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT false | Promotional rate flag |
| promotional\_start | TIMESTAMP | NULLABLE | Promo start date |
| promotional\_end | TIMESTAMP | NULLABLE | Promo end date |
| previous\_value | DECIMAL(10,4) | NULLABLE | Value before last change |
| updated\_by | UUID | NULLABLE, FOREIGN KEY → users.id | Admin who last updated |
| created\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | Config creation timestamp |
| updated\_at | TIMESTAMP | NOT NULL, DEFAULT now() | Last update timestamp |

**Relationships:**

* fee\_config.sport\_id → sports.id (sport-specific commission override)  
* fee\_config.updated\_by → users.id (admin who updated the config)

**Indexes:**

* INDEX on fee\_config.sport\_id  
* INDEX on fee\_config.is\_promotional  
* INDEX on fee\_config.promotional\_end
